title: Idempotence of the filtered-colimit hull of finitely presentable objects
statement: Fix a universe $U$ for small indexing categories and Hom sets [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a category locally small in $U$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and let $P$ be a property of its objects. Suppose each $P$-object is finitely presentable: $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(C,-)$ preserves every existing $U$-small filtered colimit whenever $P(C)$ holds. Write $\operatorname{ind}_U(P)$ for the property of being isomorphic to a colimit of a $U$-small filtered diagram all of whose objects satisfy $P$. Then $\operatorname{ind}_U(\operatorname{ind}_U(P))=\operatorname{ind}_U(P)$ as object properties. No assumption that every object of $\mathcal A$ is a filtered colimit of finitely presentable objects is imposed.
